action_summary: Play A of plan V4, executed. Deleted canonical/tools/contract_first_routing_v1.py (412 lines, the router that lost to its own ablation at 0.128 vs 0.181 on the clean quarter and 0.268 vs 0.252 leaked) and its test (96 lines), moving the surviving ablation into the scoreboard as topic_only_ranker, which reproduces the archive to four decimals (0.0957/0.1809 vs 0.096/0.181). New instrument runtime_answer_fingerprint_v1.py asks the unified model all 404 exact-target questions and hashes the transcripts. With the gate present and deleted: 404/404 identical, 0 answers moved -- so the plan's kill criterion was unmeasurable, because the gate was never in a runtime path. The fingerprint also exposed a determinism defect: find_source summed idf contributions while iterating a set, and floats do not add associatively, so 1 of 404 questions returned a different rank-3 module under another hash seed. Three loops now iterate sorted(terms); seeds 1, 2 and 7 return one digest. 16 tests pass (7 scoreboard, 4 fingerprint, 5 receipt).

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: THE VOCABULARY IS THE ARTIFACT. An effect is a computable object -- the set of relations that moved between two readings -- and a goal can only be stated, planned for and verified in relations the system carries. Experience of an atom whose effect no relation names is experience of nothing.
what_is_false_in_the_claim: that experiencing the most advanced action once installs it: mv was experienced in every cell of the probe table twice and still could not take the rename request
that repetition fixes an unstateable goal: a thousand observations of an invisible change are a thousand observations of nothing
that one demonstration identifies the rule: median 1037 surviving programs, 4 of 23 tasks identified
that an action list transfers: 0 of 20 held-out bugs at any budget; an action shape from one demonstration reaches 1-2 of 20
that any of this solves 'any computer use': the five relations are a grammar, not the world, and OSWorld 2.0's hardest phenomena need relations nobody wrote down
